description: Entropy factor in the Vmax/Jmax temperature response
source: Fatichi et al. (2012a) Table 3; underlying Kattge & Knorr (2007) Plant Cell Environ 30:1176-1190

description: Mesophyll conductance; Inf disables mesophyll limitation

description: Maximum Rubisco carboxylation capacity at 25 degC
